import openpyxl

input_path = sys.argv[1]
output_path = sys.argv[2]

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# min row (20) and max row (21) for columns B..F (units 1..5)
min_vals = {col: ws.cell(row=20, column=col).value for col in range(2, 7)}
max_vals = {col: ws.cell(row=21, column=col).value for col in range(2, 7)}

unit_cols = list(range(2, 7))  # B..F -> unit1..unit5

# Data rows: 2..18 (row 1 is header, row 19 is blank)
for r in range(2, 19):
    resid = ws.cell(row=r, column=9).value
    if resid is None:
        continue
    if resid > 0:
        # addition: unit1 -> unit5
        remaining = resid
        for col in unit_cols:  # unit1 index 0 .. unit5 index 4
            cur = ws.cell(row=r, column=col).value
            if cur == 0:
                continue  # don't change zero cells
            capacity = max_vals[col] - cur
            add = min(capacity, remaining)
            if add > 0:
                ws.cell(row=r, column=col).value = cur + add
                remaining -= add
            if remaining <= 0:
                break
    elif resid < 0:
        # subtraction: unit5 -> unit1
        remaining = -resid
        for col in reversed(unit_cols):  # unit5 .. unit1
            cur = ws.cell(row=r, column=col).value
            if cur == 0:
                continue  # don't change zero cells
            capacity = cur - min_vals[col]
            sub = min(capacity, remaining)
            if sub > 0:
                ws.cell(row=r, column=col).value = cur - sub
                remaining -= sub
            if remaining <= 0:
                break

# Set column I (residuals) values to 0 for data rows
for r in range(2, 19):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=9).value = 0

wb.save(output_path)
print("done")", "path": "/bench/answers/433-47/solution.py"}, "name": "write"}
